title: Architecture and discovery
summary: We map the system you have against the one you need, and write down why.
deliverable: A written architecture, a risk list, and a sequenced plan you own.

title: Build to production
summary: A senior team takes the plan to a running system, in your repo from day one.
deliverable: A deployed service, tests, runbooks, and the CI that ships it.

title: Rescue and migration
summary: For systems that work but cannot be changed safely any more.
deliverable: Incremental migration with a rollback at every step, no big-bang cutover.

title: Run it with you
summary: We stay on the system after launch instead of handing it to strangers.
deliverable: On-call rotation, monthly reliability review, and a shrinking backlog.
